description: Use this when the user wants Sitewalk to keep watching a website: check it regularly, re-audit it every day, week or month, or tell them when something breaks. Takes the site address and an optional frequency: daily, weekly or monthly (default monthly). Sitewalk audits the site again on that schedule and emails the user only when something changed: a different health score, new issues, or the site could not be checked. Asking again for the same site changes its frequency. The result says when the next check runs, or why the frequency is not available and which one is. Needs a signed-in Sitewalk account. Only use it for sites the user owns or is allowed to audit.
name: monitor_site
title: Monitor a site
